compiled_state.title: As a sprint operator, every commit produced via /dso:commit in sprint mode carries a DSO-Story trailer enforced by a pre-commit hook
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Pre-commit hook that validates DSO-Story (or DSO-Task/DSO-Bug routed orphan) trailer presence on every commit produced via /dso:commit when sprint mode is active. Composes on top of 170b-2ac9's trailer infrastructure; sprint mode forces attribution.enabled=true regardless of project config.
**Why**: Provides the deterministic attribution data that S5's merge orchestration, S7's leakage detector, and the post-Phase-F leakage-handling routing all consume.

**Scope**:
- IN: Pre-commit hook: validate DSO-Story trailer present using git interpret-trailers --parse
- IN: Sprint-mode override of attribution.enabled=false project config
- IN: Documented error message pointing the user to a story worktree when trailer absent
- IN: Outside sprint mode: hook is inactive; respects project's attribution.enabled setting
- OUT: Trailer injection itself — owned by 170b-2ac9 — Verified: 170b-2ac9 SC-1 covers trailer emission via git interpret-trailers

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a trailer-less commit attempted in sprint mode is rejected with the documented error message
  ← Satisfies: "SC2: Mandatory DSO-Story trailer with explicit --message injection — pre-commit hook validates trailer presence and rejects commits without a DSO trailer"
- When this story is complete, a commit attempted outside sprint mode with attribution.enabled=false succeeds with no DSO trailer enforcement
  ← Satisfies: "SC2 verification: outside sprint mode + attribution.enabled=false asserts no enforcement"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] DSO-Story trailer block format MUST match 170b-2ac9's emitted format byte-for-byte (key name casing, separator, value shape, position relative to other trailers like Co-Authored-By). Define the canonical format in this story and add a fixture test that asserts emitter (170b-2ac9) and validator (this hook) parse the same trailer string. Without an explicit shared-format contract, this hook may reject trailers that 170b-2ac9 emits or accept malformed trailers that S5's merge-message generator produces.
- [Maintainability] Coordinate pre-commit pipeline with 6d90-93d5 (Conventional Commits enforcement) — both modify pre-commit and /dso:commit; ensure the two hooks compose cleanly without ordering dependencies.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
